verdict.rationale: React uses JavaScript functions and can be embedded in existing HTML pages (react-docs-1, react-docs-8), but it requires learning JSX, a new syntax extension not standard HTML/JS (react-docs-2), plus new concepts like hooks, component state, and its own DOM abstraction that community members note is genuinely hard to grasp (react-comm-7, react-comm-8, react-comm-10) — contradicting the claim of minimal new concepts. missing for 10: evidence that plain HTML/CSS/JS suffices without JSX or a build step, and first-party acknowledgment of the learning curve rather than only community pushback.
